messages:
maya: heads-up: after last night's IdP cert rotation some EU users report immediate logout and a few SCIM role updates vanished. any visibility?

sam: reproducing. SAML OK, session cookie created then cleared. Happens in prod-eu and locally when KMS decrypt delayed. :thinking:

jen: SCIM shows 200 for PATCH but downstream role-write audit is missing. we must be swallowing a failure.

aaron: I ran KMS rekey ~02:11 UTC. metrics show a p95 spike to ~3.4s around 02:11-02:14. might overlap with active decrypts.

sam: SP logs: "Session validate: KMS decrypt failed: rpc DEADLINE_EXCEEDED" then session cleared.

maya: seems like rekey race. current SCIM path ACKs on decrypt timeout to avoid IdP retries, which silently drops role writes. that's bad.

jen: propose: 1) add audit preflight event before role write, 2) on KMS timeout return 409 once so IdP can retry, 3) implement cached-decrypt fallback with strict TTL as a short-term mitigation.

aaron: I'll do cached-decrypt fallback (24h TTL) + PR for changing ack behavior. canary to eu-prod.

maya: I'll own postmortem + timeline + KMS graphs. jen add metric counter scim_role_write_kms_timeouts.

sam: also add SP metric sp_kms_decrypt_timeouts. make vuln-triage note: swallowing KMS errors is silent-data-loss risk.

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-031-07 created: "IdP rotation overlapped KMS rekey causing decrypt timeouts -> session invalidation & SCIM role drops".

jen: short-term patch planned. long-term: coordinate rekey windows with infra and make rotations jittered.

maya: thanks team. tracking in the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
